sql: WITH h AS (SELECT s.prod_id,t.calendar_year y,t.calendar_month_number m,SUM(amount_sold) a FROM sales s JOIN customers c USING(cust_id) JOIN countries co USING(country_id) JOIN times t USING(time_id) JOIN promotions p USING(promo_id) JOIN channels ch USING(channel_id) WHERE co.country_name='France' AND p.promo_total_id=1 AND ch.channel_total_id=1 AND t.calendar_year IN(2019,2020,2021) GROUP BY 1,2,3),p AS (SELECT prod_id,m,MAX(CASE WHEN y=2019 THEN a END) a19,MAX(CASE WHEN y=2020 THEN a END) a20,MAX(CASE WHEN y=2021 THEN a END) a21 FROM h GROUP BY 1,2),v AS (SELECT 'paired_all' variant,m,a20*a20/a19 v FROM p WHERE a19>0 AND a20 IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT 'paired_2021_roster',m,a20*a20/a19 FROM p WHERE a19>0 AND a20 IS NOT NULL AND a21 IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT '2020_roster_missing_2019_zero',m,COALESCE(a20*a20/a19,0) FROM p WHERE a20 IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT '2021_roster_missing_pair_zero',m,COALESCE(a20*a20/a19,0) FROM p WHERE a21 IS NOT NULL),mon AS (SELECT variant,m,COUNT(*) n,AVG(v) a FROM v GROUP BY 1,2),r AS (SELECT *,ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY variant ORDER BY a) rn,COUNT(*) OVER(PARTITION BY variant) cnt FROM mon) SELECT variant,AVG(a) median_raw,AVG(ROUND(a,2)) median_round_monthly FROM r WHERE rn IN ((cnt+1)/2,(cnt+2)/2) GROUP BY variant
